Round173A.manuscript_quotient_structure.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  (G : Submodule ℂ H) [G.HasOrthogonalProjection] (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : ∀ x ∈ G, A x ∈ G) :
  Gᗮ.starProjection.comp A = (Round173A.S G).comp ((Round173A.Abar G A).comp (Round173A.Q G)) ∧
    ↑(Round173A.Abar G A) = Round173A.AbarLinear G A hA ∧
      (↑(Round173A.S G)).range = Gᗮ ∧
        (∀ (x : H ⧸ G), (Round173A.Q G) ((Round173A.S G) x) = x) ∧
          ‖Round173A.Q G‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖Round173A.S G‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ (x : H ⧸ G), ‖(Round173A.S G) x‖ = ‖x‖
'Round173A.manuscript_quotient_structure' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
